issue_context.title: Light turn on/off not working properly on Duotecno light entities
issue_context.body:
### The problem

Calling light.turn_off on a light that is already off, turns on the light.
Calling light.turn_on on a light that is already on, turns off the light.

### What version of Home Assistant Core has the issue?

core-2023.9.3
